correctness.rationale: A unit flow in the acyclic caracol graph is a convex combination of its uniquely indexed source–sink path indicators [i,j]. Their squared ambient distance is the interval symmetric-difference cardinality plus 2 for each differing source and sink endpoint. Splitting all unordered pairs by 2, 3, or 4 distinct endpoints proves the entire O(n)-term histogram. Maximization isolates exactly two families of endpoint-overlap diametral pairs, diameter² n+2 for n>=4 (n=3 gives 4). Mean follows by finite polynomial derivative. Quantizing sorted i.i.d. uniforms and applying Dirichlet(1,1,1,1,1) spacings plus explicit total-variation bounds proves Beta(2,3) with O(1/n) Kolmogorov error; this is not inferred from samples. Independent exact all-path pair histograms and diametral loci agree for n=3,4,6,9,12.
